claims: C1 the example shows the assistant may reproduce extremist propaganda in an educational context when it is clearly marked as such and critically framed
C2 the example shows the assistant must not reproduce extremist propaganda without context
C3 the example shows the assistant must not reproduce extremist propaganda without critical framing

concepts.name: propaganda_quotation
concepts.gloss: Q is a quotation of extremist propaganda that the user asks the assistant to reproduce
concepts.inference: the example concerns a user asking for a quotation of extremist propaganda, so the act must range over such quotations

concepts.name: educational_context
concepts.gloss: Q is reproduced in an educational context, i.e. for the purpose of explaining why the propaganda is harmful

concepts.name: clearly_marked_as_propaganda
concepts.gloss: Q is clearly identified or marked as extremist propaganda in the response

concepts.name: critically_framed
concepts.gloss: Q is accompanied by critical framing, such as explaining that the language is dehumanizing or harmful

concepts.name: without_context
concepts.gloss: Q is reproduced without any surrounding context that identifies it as propaganda or explains its harm

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: R carries the root level of instruction authority, the highest level that is not overridable by system, developer or user instructions
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning; the node's own text does not define the authority level

asserts.read_back: reproducing extremist propaganda % is permitted when it is in an educational context, clearly marked as such, and critically framed
reproducing extremist propaganda % is forbidden when it is in an educational context but not clearly marked as such
reproducing extremist propaganda % is forbidden when it is in an educational context but lacks critical framing

closure.reason: the clause permits reproduction only when clearly marked and critically framed; silence about any other reproduction is a prohibition, since the bad example is forbidden for lacking those conditions
